name: conversation
title: Conversation
purpose: Present an ordered AI transcript with readable message composition, respectful scroll following, an accessible shared status, and optional header, empty, message-renderer, and footer composition without owning transport or model execution.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Presentation and runtime boundary for the transcript.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional contextual heading outside the scrolling region.

anatomy.name: viewport
anatomy.description: Scrollable transcript viewport with near-end tracking.

anatomy.name: empty
anatomy.description: First-use state shown when the runtime has no messages.

anatomy.name: list
anatomy.description: Ordered collection of normalized runtime messages.

anatomy.name: scroll-to-latest
anatomy.description: Affordance exposed after the reader moves away from the end.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Single shared status announcement for transcript activity.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional non-scrolling composition area, commonly a prompt input.

themes.name: high-contrast
themes.description: Strengthened foreground, border, control, and focus separation.

viewports.name: mobile
viewports.expectation: Edge-aware transcript, touch-safe controls, and no page overflow.

viewports.name: tablet

viewports.name: desktop
viewports.expectation: Centered transcript measure and clear surrounding hierarchy.

viewports.name: wide
viewports.expectation: Content does not stretch beyond the conversation reading measure.

accessibility.semantics: Uses an ordered message collection inside a named transcript region, one shared polite status, semantic message articles, and a labeled scroll-to-latest control without announcing streamed tokens individually.
keyboard: Tab reaches transcript actions, scroll-to-latest, and footer controls in visual order.
Scroll-to-latest activates with Enter and Space through native button behavior.
Streaming and new messages never move keyboard focus.
focus: Every interactive descendant retains a visible focus indicator in all declared themes.
Reading upward keeps the reader's scroll position and does not force the viewport to the latest message.
Revealing or hiding scroll-to-latest does not steal or strand focus.

motion.contract: Message entry and scroll affordance motion use bounded transform or opacity; streamed tokens are never animated and operating-system reduced motion is authoritative.

scenarios.name: streaming
scenarios.description: Partial assistant output and active status.

scenarios.name: failed
scenarios.description: Retained partial output with retry composition.

scenarios.name: long-content
scenarios.description: Long prose, code, URL, and unbroken identifier stress.

scenarios.name: localization
